FREE Media Downloader Version 1.5.1 (2026-09-21) RoutineHub 26384. If the listing is newer than this number, update from there.
Sites: YouTube, YouTube Music, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, Reddit, Pinterest, LinkedIn, Snapchat, Vimeo, DailyMotion, SoundCloud.
Facebook resolves on the phone in one request: videos and Reels from the video player, photos from the public post embed.
YouTube and Instagram: yt-dlp in a-Shell mini. Video and photos go to Photos. Audio goes to Files. TikTok: no-watermark when the source lets it. X, Bluesky, Mastodon and Pinterest use the server extractor and the other free backends. Share a link. Save the file. No key. No paywall. No upgrade nag. First Photos, Files, and a-Shell prompts: approve once. A sign-in wall opens Safari or the app. Share again after.
TikTok: save without watermark when the source allows it. Straight to Photos.
YouTube always uses yt-dlp in a-Shell mini. First run may install yt-dlp plus the YouTube JS helper. Video goes to Photos. Audio goes to Files.

U="￼"; pip show yt-dlp-ejs yt-dlp-apple-webkit-jsi >/dev/null 2>&1 || pip install -U "yt-dlp[default]" yt-dlp-ejs yt-dlp-apple-webkit-jsi; SC="${SHORTCUTS:-}"; [ -n "$SC" ] || SC=~shortcuts; mkdir -p "$SC"; printf missing > "$SC/fed-kind.txt"; printf txt > "$SC/fed-ext.txt"; touch "$SC/fed-media"; CK=""; if [ -f "$HOME/Documents/cookies.txt" ]; then CK="--cookies $HOME/Documents/cookies.txt"; fi; FMT="b"; EMB=""; AUD=""; if command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null 2>&1; then FMT="bv*+ba/b"; EMB="--embed-thumbnail --embed-chapters"; fi; case "$U" in *music.youtube*|*music.youtu*) AUD="-x --audio-format m4a"; FMT="bestaudio/b"; EMB=""; esac; rm -f "$HOME/Documents"/fed-dl.*; yt-dlp $CK $AUD $EMB -f "$FMT" -S "ext:mp4:m4a" --no-mtime --no-part --force-overwrites -P "$HOME/Documents" -o "fed-dl.%(ext)s" -- "$U"; f=$(ls -t "$HOME/Documents"/fed-dl.* 2>/dev/null | sed -n 1p); if [ -n "$f" ] && [ -s "$f" ]; then cp "$f" "$SC/fed-media"; ext="${f##*.}"; printf "%s" "$ext" | tr "A-Z" "a-z" > "$SC/fed-ext.txt"; case "$(cat "$SC/fed-ext.txt")" in mp3|m4a|opus|ogg|flac|wav|aac|wma) printf audio > "$SC/fed-kind.txt";; *) printf photo > "$SC/fed-kind.txt";; esac; fi; sleep 0.2; open shortcuts://
